id.description: The globally unique generated id for the session.

sessionStoreId.description:
The id of the {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore} instance that is the
parent for this session.

meta.description:
Contains metadata about object creation and update times. This field is intended to help
implementations of {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore.RetentionPolicy}.

title:
Interface for metadata associated with a "session." A session implies state that is saved **across** multiple calls.
For example, a user could have a session that represents a single conversation thread.
@see GenaiCore.SessionStore#sessions
The session object is used with various {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore} APIs such as `updateState`, `getState`, etc.
name: GenaiCore.Session
